description: Implementation of OS-specific utility functions for Windows, including process management, crash handling, stack tracing, and file operations, used within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: CustomStackWalker
classes.description: Custom implementation of StackWalker to output call stack information.

classes.name: ScopedPipe
classes.description: Manages creation and cleanup of Windows pipes for process I/O.

classes.name: WindowsProcess
classes.description: Encapsulates process creation, management, and termination on Windows.

methods.name: PrintBacktrace
methods.description: Outputs a call stack trace given a CONTEXT object.

methods.name: StackTraceCrashHandler
methods.description: Handles exceptions by printing crash info and backtrace, then exits.

methods.name: CrashHandler
methods.description: Main exception handler that invokes user callback and crash handler.

methods.name: ReadFromFile
methods.description: Reads data from a handle into a string, handling blocking or non-blocking mode.
